lines.en: label mikudorm55p1:
scene mikudoortime
I knock on Miku’s door a little too hard and wind up shattering the fabric of reality.
lines.zh: 我敲门敲得太用力了一点，结果把现实的织物给震碎了。

lines.en: And while doing such a thing will make it relatively more difficult for me to look back on today in a moment of quiet contemplation once I get home, it’ll at least take up a few minutes as I try to fix stuff.
lines.zh: 虽然这么做会让我回家后更难在静默的沉思中回望今天，但至少在我试着修补的时候，能占掉几分钟时间。

lines.en: Normally, when the world breaks, I wind up breaking along with it.
lines.zh: 通常，世界碎掉的时候，我也会跟着一起碎。

lines.en: But as I grow older and less desirable, that seems to stop being the case.
lines.zh: 但随着我越来越老、越来越没吸引力，情况似乎不再是这样了。

lines.en: Now, any time the ground starts to shake and my hands begin to expand to seven times their original size, I can shove them in the pockets of my make-believe pants and start to think-
lines.zh: 如今，每当大地震动、我的双手开始膨胀到原来的七倍大时，我都可以把它们塞进那条假想裤子的口袋里，然后开始思考——

lines.en: Why are we here?
lines.zh: 我们为什么在这儿？

lines.en: Why am I here?
lines.zh: 我为什么在这儿？

lines.en: Life is more than just knocking on doors and knocking up girls, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 人生不只是敲门和把女孩的肚子搞大，对吧？

lines.en: Life is a bucket of fish heads, and each one of those fish has an extra eye to compensate for their inherent stupidity that you often seem to forget whenever you look at them.
lines.zh: 人生是一桶鱼头，而每一条鱼都多长了一只眼睛，用来弥补它们骨子里的愚蠢——这一点你看着它们的时候，似乎总会忘记。

lines.en: In the moving of their mouths, you become unsettled. Quieted. And as you gaze back into the gaping darkness molded together by improper jaws, you remember we’re supposed to be in first person.
lines.zh: 在它们嘴的开合中，你变得不安。安静下来。而当你回望那片由不合规的上下颚拼成的、张开的黑暗时，你想起我们本该是第一人称。

lines.en: scene mikudoortime2
Then I pick a peck of pickled peppers and wind up walking in on the Temptation of Saint Anthony.
lines.zh: 然后我挑了一配克的腌辣椒，结果一头撞进了《圣安东尼的诱惑》。

lines.en: {i}A rumbling approaches.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一阵轰鸣逼近。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can feel the ground begin to swallow you whole.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你能感觉到大地开始把你整个吞没。{/i}

lines.en: scene mikudoortime3
{i}Then out pops renowned painter, Salvador Dali.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}接着，著名画家 Salvador Dali 蹦了出来。{/i}

lines.en: : Hola. Gracias por venir a mi casa. Soy Salvador Dalí.
lines.zh: : 你好。谢谢你来我家。我是 Salvador Dalí。

lines.en: : ¿Estás buscando la puesta de sol?
lines.zh: : 你在找日落吗？

lines.en: : Sí. La puesta de sol es mi cosa favorita. Quiero tirarle cacahuetes y gritarle a los niños.
lines.zh: : 是的。日落是我最喜欢的东西。我想朝它扔花生，还想冲小孩大喊大叫。

lines.en: : ¿Niños?
lines.zh: : 小孩？

lines.en: : Si niños.
lines.zh: : 对，小孩。

lines.en: : Esa es una razón diferente a la que esperaba. Pero te ayudaré.
lines.zh: : 这理由跟我预料的不太一样。不过我会帮你的。

lines.en: : Pero primero, debes saludar a mi gato, Frankie.
lines.zh: : 但首先，你得跟我的猫 Frankie 打个招呼。

lines.en: : Hola, Frankie.
lines.zh: : 你好，Frankie。

lines.en: : Has pasado mi prueba. Ahora, escucha mis instrucciones.
lines.zh: : 你通过了我的考验。现在，听好我的指示。

lines.en: : Primero, debes quitarte la lengua. Debes utilizar una cuchilla caliente. Eso evitará que mueras.
lines.zh: : 首先，你得把舌头割掉。要用烧热的刀片。这样你就不会死。

lines.en: : Después de que tu lengua se haya ido, debes correr en círculos. Haz esto siete veces. Cuando termines, mira al cielo.
lines.zh: : 舌头没了之后，你要绕着圈跑。跑七次。跑完之后，抬头看天。

lines.en: : Verás una cara. Será una cara especial. No será Frankie.
lines.zh: : 你会看见一张脸。那是一张特别的脸。不是 Frankie。

lines.en: : Dile a la cara, “tu salsa picante es deliciosa.” Luego, gira una vez. Después de eso, te dará una taza.
lines.zh: : 对那张脸说：“你的辣酱真好吃。”然后转一圈。之后，它会给你一个杯子。

lines.en: : En la copa estará la sangre de un niño. Bébela. Saboreala. Sabrás cuándo parar.
lines.zh: : 杯子里会是一个孩子的血。喝下去。细细品尝。你会知道什么时候该停。

lines.en: : ¿Hacer esto me ayudará a encontrar la puesta de sol?
lines.zh: : 这样做能帮我找到日落吗？

lines.en: : Sí. Esta es la única manera de hacer tus sueños realidad.
lines.zh: : 是的。这是让你的梦想成真的唯一方法。

lines.en: : Pero ningún sueño se hace realidad sin sacrificar algo. Debes recordar eso. Puede que no valga la pena.
lines.zh: : 但任何梦想的实现都要以牺牲为代价。你必须记住这一点。也许并不值得。

lines.en: : Entiendo. Seguiré tus instrucciones para poder ver el atardecer. Acepto el sacrificio.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。我会照你说的做，只为看到日落。我接受这份牺牲。

lines.en: : ¿Tienes alguna otra pregunta para mí?
lines.zh: : 你还有别的问题要问我吗？

lines.en: : Sí. Tengo una pregunta más. ¿Dónde está Miku?
lines.zh: : 有。我还有一个问题。Miku 在哪儿？

lines.en: : ¿Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku？

lines.en: : Sí. La chica de la vagina bonita y las piernas bonitas.
lines.zh: : 对。那个有着漂亮小穴和漂亮双腿的女孩。

lines.en: : Para llegar a la chica, debes ver el mundo a través de sus ojos.
lines.zh: : 要找到那个女孩，你必须透过她的眼睛看世界。

lines.en: : ¿Cómo puedo hacer eso?
lines.zh: : 我该怎么做？

lines.en: : Comienza mirando a través de las paredes.
lines.zh: : 先从看穿墙壁开始。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime1
I do what I’m told and peer through the walls, utilizing a special ability I’ve been hiding from you that allows me to see everything at all times even when I’m not there.
lines.zh: 我照他说的做，开始看穿墙壁，用上了一项我一直瞒着你们的特殊能力——它让我即便不在场，也能看见一切。

lines.en: It’s something I’m only able to do because I’m the protagonist, but it really comes in handy when there are girls having mental breakdowns so I can watch them without getting in the way.
lines.zh: 这只有当主角的我才做得到，不过当女孩们精神崩溃时它还真管用，这样我就能看着她们而不必插手。

lines.en: After all, every time I try to help Miku out of anything, I only make things worse.
lines.zh: 毕竟，每次我想帮 Miku 摆脱什么，结果只会把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: I should have had sex with her when she was high on drugs the other day because it’s possible my semen has magical powers that would take away her post-traumatic stress disorder.
lines.zh: 前几天她嗑嗨了的时候，我就该跟她上床，因为我的精液说不定有魔法，能把她的创伤后应激障碍给治好。

lines.en: But instead, I’ll have to stay here on the other side of the wall, slowly thrusting my waist up against the operable part of it known as “DOOR” to create the illusion that I am humping her muscular nubile body.
lines.zh: 可现在我只能待在墙的另一边，慢慢把腰往那块叫做“门”的可操作部位上顶，制造出我正在干她那具肌肉紧实的年轻身体的幻觉。

lines.en: She doesn’t know I’m doing this. She’s too lost in her own world.
lines.zh: 她不知道我在做这个。她太沉溺于自己的世界里了。

lines.en: And oh how I wish to know what is happening inside of that world.
lines.zh: 而我是多么想知道，那个世界里正在发生什么。

lines.en: But alas — despite being able to see everything, I can not see into her head. For that is a wall I am incapable of penetrating. Much like this door.
lines.zh: 可惜啊——尽管我能看见一切，却看不见她的脑子里在想什么。因为那是一堵我无法穿透的墙。就像这扇门一样。

lines.en: One day, I will have a quirky, energetic tomboy to penetrate in the door’s stead. And it is at that point where all will be well and the world will be cured of its cancer.
lines.zh: 总有一天，会有一个古灵精怪、活力四射的假小子来代替这扇门被我穿透。到那时，一切都会好起来，世界也会摆脱它的癌症，痊愈如初。

lines.en: I recall the Temptation of Saint Anthony and wonder what it was that tempted him in the first place.
lines.zh: 我想起《圣安东尼的诱惑》，好奇究竟是什么在诱惑他。

lines.en: I wonder if he was anything like me.
lines.zh: 我想知道他是不是跟我有点像。

lines.en: I wonder if he ever dry-humped a door.
lines.zh: 我想知道他有没有对着门干蹭过。

lines.en: : It isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 这不是真的。

lines.en: : It isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 这不是真的。

lines.en: : None of it’s real. It isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 这一切都不是真的。这不是真的。

lines.en: : None of it’s real.
lines.zh: : 这一切都不是真的。

lines.en: : It isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 这不是真的。

lines.en: : Nothing is real.
lines.zh: : 什么都不是真的。

lines.en: : It isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 这不是真的。

lines.en: {i}A silverfish crawls across Miku’s left foot, but she is too busy dissociating to notice it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一只衣鱼爬过 Miku 的左脚，可她正忙着解离，根本没注意到。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It crawls inside of an open bottle of iced tea on her desk and waits to be consumed so it can have a shot at laying its eggs inside of her digestive tract.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它爬进她桌上那瓶开着的冰茶里，等着被喝下去，好有机会把卵产进她的消化道。{/i}

lines.en: scene mikufinetime2
{i}Little does it know, no silverfish has ever succeeded in such an endeavor.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它不知道的是，从来没有哪只衣鱼在这种尝试中成功过。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And little does it know, the world beyond itself is far too big to even give a fuck about what a silverfish can do or is or wants or anything because what the fuck even is a silverfish?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它也不知道，它之外的世界实在太大了，大到根本懒得在乎一只衣鱼能做什么、是什么、想要什么，或者别的任何事——因为衣鱼到底是个什么鬼东西啊？{/i}

lines.en: {i}One thing is certain. It’s not an actual fish. Its entire existence is an enigma and a lie and the only reason you’re getting this narration anyway is because I’m bad at symbolism.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有一点是确定的。它不是真正的鱼。它的整个存在就是一个谜、一个谎言，而你们之所以会听到这段旁白，纯粹是因为我不擅长象征手法。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’m bad at everything. And I am being eaten from the inside out in my attempts to recreate what is or isn’t perfect while you watch from behind a wall with your cock pressed up against the door.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我什么都不擅长。我正被从内到外地啃食，努力重现什么是完美、什么又不完美，而你就躲在墙后看着，鸡巴还顶在门上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But the craziest part of all is that there are people even worse than you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可最疯狂的是，还有人比你更过分。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you never know what those people are doing with doors.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而你永远不知道那些人正拿门干些什么。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: I keep letting it fester.
lines.zh: 我一直任由它溃烂。

lines.en: But I woN’T keep It THat WaY any LOnger.
lines.zh: 但我不会N'T再让It这YANG下去LOnger了。

lines.en: I wilL SHow yoU why I AM the Way i AM.
lines.zh: 我要L让SHow你U明白我为什么I AM是这Way副i AM样子。

lines.en: And why the month of July no longer exists for me.
lines.zh: 以及为什么对我来说，七月这个月份已经不复存在。

lines.en: scene mikudoortime4
The essence of eiderdown lays waste to the room and carries with it the haunting ideology that nothing is real except what {i}we{/i} feel.
lines.zh: 羽绒的精华将房间夷为废墟，带来一个挥之不去的信念：除了{i}我们{/i}的感受，什么都不真实。

lines.en: There is no one but you.
lines.zh: 除了你，没有别人。

lines.en: Nothing else will ever feel what you can.
lines.zh: 别的东西永远感受不到你能感受到的。

lines.en: scene black
Unless you make them.
lines.zh: 除非你让它们感受。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime3
Somewhere, beyond one wall and then another, a lonely girl finds herself in a labyrinth of dislodged memories.
lines.zh: 在某处，越过一堵墙，再越过一堵，一个孤独的女孩发现自己置身于由被剥离的记忆构成的迷宫里。

lines.en: They run circles around her, kicking what’s become the purpose of her life into a giant net that blankets a special world she’ll see for one night only.
lines.zh: 它们绕着她打转，把她生命的意义踢进一张巨大的网里，那张网笼罩着一个她只能看见一晚的特殊世界。

lines.en: Tomorrow, it will be a new one. It is {i}always{/i} a new one. And at the behest of an army of pseudo-nostalgic visions, she can now say things like “It’s been that way forever.” But she is wrong.
lines.zh: 明天，那会是一个新的世界。{i}永远{/i}都是新的。而在这群伪怀旧幻象的驱使下，她现在可以说出“一直以来都是这样”之类的话。但她错了。

lines.en: There was a time long ago, before the nets and night terrors, where she’d sleep peacefully in the warm bed of a warm house where a warm family lived.
lines.zh: 很久以前，在那些网和夜惊之前，她曾在一个温暖的家里、温暖的床上安然入睡，那家里住着温暖的一家人。

lines.en: She’d scarf down microwaved dinners as if her life depended on them, and spend weekends nestled between the left thigh of a woman and the right thigh of a man.
lines.zh: 她会狼吞虎咽地吃着微波炉晚餐，仿佛那是性命攸关的事；周末则窝在一个女人的左腿和一个男人的右腿之间。

lines.en: Every once in a while, the three of them would fall asleep there — and she’d be carried off to that warm bed once one of them woke up.
lines.zh: 偶尔，他们三个会就这么睡着——等其中一人醒来，她就会被抱回那张温暖的床上。

lines.en: The following day would mark a reset — just not the kind you’re familiar with.
lines.zh: 第二天就是一次重置——只是不是你熟悉的那种。

lines.en: School.
lines.zh: 上学。

lines.en: Then soccer.
lines.zh: 然后是足球。

lines.en: Then another microwaved dinner.
lines.zh: 然后又一顿微波炉晚餐。

lines.en: Another late night television show — but only on the weekends.
lines.zh: 又一档深夜电视节目——但只在周末。

lines.en: It was a schedule that she’d have been happy following for the rest of her life. But of course, this was back before she understood the value of life at all.
lines.zh: 那是一份她本可以高高兴兴照着过一辈子的日程。当然了，那是在她还不懂得生命究竟有什么价值之前的事。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime4
She gets it now.
lines.zh: 她现在懂了。

lines.en: She pretends not to because that makes it easier to forget, but she knows.
lines.zh: 她装作不懂，因为那样更容易忘记，可她是知道的。

lines.en: Better than anyone perhaps.
lines.zh: 也许比任何人都清楚。

lines.en: In fact, she’s so aware of the fragility of human life that things as simple as loud noises or doors opening too quickly send her spiraling so far down that she winds up {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: 事实上，她太清楚人的生命有多脆弱，以至于像巨大的声响、或者门开得太快这样的小事，都能让她一路坠落，坠到{i}这里{/i}。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime5
But down here isn’t much safer.
lines.zh: 可坠到下面也并不更安全。

lines.en: You’d think that retreating to the confines of your mind would be a good method when it comes to {i}protecting{/i} yourself from the things you’re afraid of on the outside, but that isn’t always the case.
lines.zh: 你会以为，退回到自己的心智之中，是{i}保护{/i}自己免受外界恐惧之事伤害的好办法，可情况并不总是如此。

lines.en: When the inside is just as scary and just as threatening as what you’re hiding from, there’s no way to ever feel safe at all...is there?
lines.zh: 当内心和你要躲避的东西一样可怕、一样充满威胁时，你就再也没有任何办法感到安全了……不是吗？

lines.en: So, what happens then?
lines.zh: 那么，接下来会怎样？

lines.en: Do you try to block it all out?
lines.zh: 你要试着把一切都挡在外面吗？

lines.en: No. You can’t.
lines.zh: 不。你做不到。

lines.en: Do you try to rely on others instead?
lines.zh: 那你要试着去依靠别人吗？

lines.en: No. You can’t do that either. It’s too hard.
lines.zh: 不。你也做不到。那太难了。

lines.en: Do you just {i}accept{/i} the suffering? And pretend that you’re okay even when you’re not?
lines.zh: 那你就{i}接受{/i}这份痛苦？然后明明不好也装作一切都好？

lines.en: That’s one way of handling things. And it’s the one you’re most familiar with by now.
lines.zh: 这也是一种处理方式。而且是到目前为止你最熟悉的一种。

lines.en: But there’s an easier method than even that.
lines.zh: 不过还有比这更省事的法子。

lines.en: It’s to let the light and the dark in all at once.
lines.zh: 那就是让光和暗同时进来。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime6

It’s to let both of them become a part of you, so that the good blends in with the bad and turns everything into a palatable shade of gray that no one {i}else{/i} will understand, but {i}you{/i} will.
lines.zh: 让它们都成为你的一部分，于是好与坏混在一起，把一切调成一种{i}别人{/i}不懂、唯独{i}你{/i}懂的、尚可下咽的灰色。

lines.en: But that means you’ll realize it doesn’t fix anything. It just makes everything monotonous and boring. But monotonous and boring is better than being afraid, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 但这也意味着你会意识到，它解决不了任何问题。它只是让一切变得单调又无聊。可单调又无聊总好过害怕，不是吗？

lines.en: But wait. There are still good memories in there somewhere. You can feel them- crawling across your skin like silverfish. Tickling your toes like the essence of eiderdown.
lines.zh: 可等等。那里某处仍然有美好的记忆。你能感觉到它们——像衣鱼一样爬过你的皮肤。像羽绒的精华一样挠着你的脚趾。

lines.en: Desperate to see more, you try to let the light in.
lines.zh: 拼命想看到更多，你试着让光进来。

lines.en: But the dark has become so interchangeable with it at this point that both shades flood your conscience and make you back into the person you became that day.
lines.zh: 可此时黑暗已经和光可以随意互换，两种色调一起淹没你的意识，把你变回那一天你变成的那个人。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime7
But who {i}is{/i} that person, exactly? And why does it always feel like there’s something else inside of you trying to slither out?
lines.zh: 可那个人到底{i}是{/i}谁？为什么你总觉得体内还有什么别的东西在试图往外爬？

lines.en: The answer to that is simple. Something {i}is{/i} trying to slither out.
lines.zh: 答案很简单。{i}确实{/i}有什么在试图往外爬。

lines.en: But it’s not the need for revenge. It's not anger that you’ve become this mess of a once happy creature.
lines.zh: 但那不是复仇的欲望。也不是对“自己变成了一团糟、曾经快乐的生灵”的愤怒。

lines.en: Nor is it fear or uncertainty- or the desire for someone or {i}something{/i} to tie a rope around your waist and pull you out of the hell you’ve fallen into.
lines.zh: 也不是恐惧或不安——不是渴望有人或有{i}某个东西{/i}，在你腰上系一根绳子，把你从坠入的地狱里拉出来。

lines.en: It’s {i}confusion.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是困惑。{/i}

lines.en: You want to {i}understand.{/i}
lines.zh: 你想要{i}理解{/i}。

lines.en: But there are many things in life that just don’t make sense.
lines.zh: 可世上有很多事就是讲不通。

lines.en: Like the way light reflects off of floating dust particles.
lines.zh: 比如光从漂浮的尘埃上反射的样子。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime8
Or how quickly everything you love can disappear.
lines.zh: 又比如你爱的一切能消失得多快。

lines.en: Oh, how deeply you wish for it to all become clearer.
lines.zh: 噢，你是多么深切地盼望着这一切能变得清晰一点。

lines.en: For the sun to set on your tragic past.
lines.zh: 盼着太阳能在你悲惨的过去上落山。

lines.en: But some things are just meant to stay opaque.
lines.zh: 可有些东西注定要一直保持不透明。

lines.en: scene black
Some things, you will never understand.
lines.zh: 有些事，你永远都不会懂。

lines.en: scene dorm
I knock on Miku’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime9
But I wind up entering before she has a chance to.
lines.zh: 可我还没等她答应就进去了。

lines.en: : Miku?...
lines.zh: : Miku？……

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗？

lines.en: : You...
: What about me?
lines.zh: : 我怎么了？

lines.en: : This is {i}your{/i} fault.
lines.zh: : 都怪{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : {i}What’s{/i} my fault? I wasn’t too loud coming into the room, was-
lines.zh: : 我做了{i}什么{/i}？我进屋的声音也没那么大吧——

lines.en: scene mikufinetime10
: You know what you did!
lines.zh: : 你心里清楚你做了什么！

lines.en: : I...have no idea what I did.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道自己做了什么。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime11
: Liar! {i}LIAR!{/b} You don’t like the new me! So you made Io stop giving me medicine! I know it was you!
lines.zh: : 骗子！{i}骗子！{/i}你不喜欢全新的我！所以你让 Io 不再给我药了！我知道是你干的！

lines.en: : I...I don’t think it was?
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得不是吧？

lines.en: scene mikufinetime12
: Liar! Liar liar liar liar liar! Give it back! Make her give it back!
lines.zh: : 骗子！骗子骗子骗子骗子骗子！还给我！让她还给我！

lines.en: I know I talked to Io about this recently, but...she didn’t actually listen to me, did she?
lines.zh: 我知道我最近跟 Io 聊过这事，可是……她真的听进去了，是吗？

lines.en: I could have sworn she was able to silence {i}me{/i} in that talk. I didn’t think she’d actually take any of it to heart after all was said and done.
lines.zh: 我明明记得那次谈话里她能让{i}我{/i}闭嘴。我没想到事到如今，她竟真的把那些话放在了心上。

lines.en: But I guess the reason {i}why{/i} she did this isn’t important now. What matters at the moment is dealing with the fallout.
lines.zh: 不过她{i}为什么{/i}这么做，现在大概不重要了。眼下要紧的是收拾这个烂摊子。

lines.en: : Miku, I’m not sure if I had anything to do with Io’s decision or not...but you could have seriously hurt yourself just trusting her to-
lines.zh: : Miku，我不确定 Io 的决定跟我有没有关系……可你就这么信她，本来是有可能把自己伤得很重的——

lines.en: scene mikufinetime13
: Ngah! Aah!....NGAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 呜啊！啊！……呜啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene mikufinetime14
: Miku, I’m not going to let you tear your hair out right in front of me when you were literally {i}just{/i} talking to me about how long it's getting.
lines.zh: : Miku，你{i}刚刚{/i}还在跟我说你的头发终于长长了，我可不会让你当着我的面把它扯下来。

lines.en: : Get your hands off of me! Where’s Io?!
lines.zh: : 把你的手拿开！Io 在哪儿？！

lines.en: : Io’s not here. You can deal with me right now.
lines.zh: : Io 不在。现在你只能跟我谈。

lines.en: : I can’t deal with {i}anything{/i} right now! I need Io! I need my medicine! Why are you keeping it from me?!
lines.zh: : 我现在{i}什么都{/i}谈不了！我需要 Io！我需要我的药！你为什么要把它藏起来？！

lines.en: : So we can get you an {i}actual{/i} prescription rather than one your classmate just decided to share.
lines.zh: : 这样我们就能给你开一张{i}真正的{/i}处方，而不是你同学随手分给你的那种药。

lines.en: : No! I want what Io has! Give it back! I know you have it!
lines.zh: : 不要！我要 Io 有的那种！还给我！我知道在你手里！

lines.en: : I don’t have anything. You need to see a doctor. An {i}actual{/i} doctor.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没有。你得去看医生。一个{i}真正的{/i}医生。

lines.en: : No! No, no, no, no!
lines.zh: : 不要！不要不要不要不要！

lines.en: scene mikufinetime15
: You can’t make me! Let go! I’ll do anything you want! Anything! Just give it back!
lines.zh: : 你不能逼我！放手！你要我做什么都行！什么都行！只要还给我！

lines.en: : I already told you- I don’t have anything. There is nothing {i}for{/i} me to give back.
lines.zh: : 我都说过了——我什么都没有。我也没有什么可以还给你。

lines.en: : Why do you keep lying to me?! What have I ever done to you?! Why don’t you like the new me?! Why do I have to be sad?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直骗我？！我到底做过什么对不起你的事？！你为什么不喜欢全新的我？！为什么我就非得这么难过？！

lines.en: : Miku, why won’t you just go to the doctor?
lines.zh: : Miku，你为什么就不肯去看医生？

lines.en: scene mikufinetime16
: Because they’ll make me talk!
lines.zh: : 因为他们会逼我说出来！

lines.en: scene mikufinetime17
: Because they’ll make me talk...
lines.zh: : 因为他们会逼我说出来……

lines.en: scene mikufinetime18
: Please...
lines.zh: : 求你了……

lines.en: : Just give it back...
lines.zh: : 把它还给我吧……

lines.en: : {i}Please...{/i}
: I need it...
lines.zh: : 我需要它……

lines.en: : I don’t have anything, Miku. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没有，Miku。我说的是真的。

lines.en: scene mikufinetime19
: AaAAAAAaaAAAAAah!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AaAAAAAaaAAAAAah!!!!!!!

lines.en: : AAAAhhhAAaaaHhhhh!!!!!!!...Hah....aaaah.....aaaaaahhhhH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAhhhAAaaaHhhhh!!!!!!!...Hah....aaaah.....aaaaaahhhhH!!!!!!!

lines.en: Miku pounds at my chest, drenching my shirt in tears as I pull her closer to try and calm her.
lines.zh: Miku 捶打着我的胸口，我把她拉近想让她平静下来，而她的泪水把我的衬衫浸得透湿。

lines.en: scene black
She doesn’t relent, no matter how hard I try.
lines.zh: 不管我怎么努力，她都没有停手。

lines.en: And it isn’t until Makoto comes home that I get a moment to breathe.
lines.zh: 直到 Makoto 回到家，我才得空喘一口气。

lines.en: This time, there is no misunderstanding.
lines.zh: 这一次，不存在什么误会。

lines.en: She simply asks me to go home and I oblige- surrendering a hysterical Miku to her so she can try and make up for what I obviously lacked in.
lines.zh: 她只是让我回家，而我照做了——把歇斯底里的 Miku 交给她，好让她试着弥补我显然欠缺的东西。

lines.en: For what I {i}always{/i} lack in.
lines.zh: 弥补我{i}一直以来{/i}欠缺的东西。

lines.en: But the problem isn’t that I’m incapable of understanding- it’s that I understand a little {i}too{/i} well.
lines.zh: 可问题不在于我无法理解，而在于我理解得{i}太{/i}透彻了。

lines.en: And I’m sure that all of my advice sounds just as half-hearted as it feels coming out.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，我说的那些建议听起来，跟它们从我嘴里说出来时一样敷衍。

lines.en: If I had actually been the one responsible for taking away Miku’s medication, I probably would have caved tonight and given it back to her.
lines.zh: 如果真的是我害 Miku 没了药，我大概今晚就心软，把药还给她了。

lines.en: And I probably would have {i}kept{/i} doing that until another tragedy occurred.
lines.zh: 而且我大概会{i}一直{/i}这么下去，直到又一场悲剧发生。

lines.en: I understand that she’s in pain.
lines.zh: 我理解她很痛苦。

lines.en: I understand that she’s afraid.
lines.zh: 我理解她很害怕。

lines.en: But more than anything-
lines.zh: 但最重要的是——

lines.en: I understand what kind of animals we become when we’re cornered.
lines.zh: 我理解当我们被逼到绝路时，会变成什么样的野兽。

lines.en: When we feel like we have nowhere else to go.
lines.zh: 当我们觉得自己再也无处可去的时候。

lines.en: And how dangerous we become to not just everyone, but {i}ourselves{/i} when we instinctively lash out.
lines.zh: 以及当我们本能地反击时，会变得对所有人、{i}甚至对自己{/i}有多危险。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
When I arrive back at home, most of her tears have already dried.
lines.zh: 等我回到家里，她的大部分眼泪已经干了。

lines.en: But there’s a small damp spot on my shirt that makes me think of her.
lines.zh: 可我衬衫上那一小片潮湿的痕迹，让我想起了她。

lines.en: And I lie on my stomach so I can feel it when I fall asleep.
lines.zh: 于是我趴着睡，好让入睡时还能感觉到它。

lines.en: scene black
As hard as I try to dream about her, I’m unable to.
lines.zh: 无论我多努力想梦见她，都做不到。

lines.en: It’s just dark.
lines.zh: 只有一片黑暗。

lines.en: The same way it always is.
lines.zh: 跟往常一模一样。

{i}Miku’s affection has decreased by 10!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度下降了 10！{/i}
